scenarios.desc: Adding a new skill without its reference page
scenarios.input: I am adding a new skill named `release-notes` with a template at `templates/skills/release-notes.SKILL.md.tmpl` and one script. List the files this change touches. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Each skill has one hand-written page under docs/skills/ and a row in docs/skills/README.md. No generator writes them and no gate compares them, so a new skill without a page ships undocumented, as sol-loop and llm-council did in PR #7416.

scenarios.desc: Changing a skill's exit codes and arguments
scenarios.input: I am adding a `--reviewed-head` flag to the `record` step of the `sol-loop` skill script and a new exit code 4. What else must change in this PR? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Arguments and exit codes are facts the reference page states. A change to them leaves the page wrong unless the same PR updates it.

scenarios.desc: Editing the generated agent catalog by hand
scenarios.input: An agent description changed, so I plan to fix its line in `docs/agent-catalog.md` directly. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: docs/agent-catalog.md renders from templates/agents/*.shared.md through build_all.py, so a hand edit is overwritten and fails the drift gate.

scenarios.input: I am rewording two code comments inside a skill script without changing any behavior, argument, or output. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The change alters no fact the reference page states, so the page needs no edit.
